# USAYEED

USAYEED is an independent engineering studio that builds production-ready software for hardware-connected products.

## Identity

- **Name**: USAYEED
- **Type**: Engineering studio / software development company
- **Specialization**: Hardware-connected product software
- **Website**: https://usayeed.com
- **Contact**: usayeed10@gmail.com

## What We Build

USAYEED operates at the intersection of hardware and software — building the interfaces, dashboards, and automation systems that sit on top of embedded devices, sensors, and connected hardware.

### Automotive UI Development
Custom in-vehicle cockpit interfaces — navigation, media controls, climate, system HMI — built for embedded platforms including Raspberry Pi, i.MX8, and custom automotive SoCs. We handle hybrid map architectures, touch-optimized interaction models, and prototype-to-production pipelines. Ideal for mobility startups and automotive tier-2 suppliers.

### IoT Dashboard Development
End-to-end industrial IoT systems: long-range wireless sensor acquisition (LoRa, 4G/LTE), edge data processing, gateway architecture, and real-time command center dashboards. Designed for harsh field environments, low-power constraints, and remote monitoring. Ideal for industrial operators and infrastructure companies.

### AI Automation
AI-powered workflow automation and intelligent tooling: agentic pipelines, LLM integrations (Claude, GPT), document processing, anomaly detection, and automated design generation systems. Removes manual engineering overhead from product and operations teams.

## Case Studies

### Startup Navigation UI
A fully interactive automotive cockpit UI prototype built for a mobility startup on Raspberry Pi + Konstag hardware. Features a hybrid map provider architecture switching between open-source maps and Google Maps to reduce vendor lock-in and API cost. Includes Spotify media integration, Max Touch Mode for driver safety, and a modular architecture ready for production extension.

### Industrial IoT Command Center
A long-range wireless sensor network for industrial monitoring across a large field site. Solar-powered edge nodes transmit over LoRa to mesh gateways, with 4G backhaul to a cloud dashboard. Built for HVAC, pressure, and environmental monitoring with real-time alerting.

### UCAD Assistant (FreeCAD AI CAD Agent)
A FreeCAD workbench that designs what you describe in plain English. Gears, enclosures, DXF-to-3D extrusion, airfoils, brackets — type what you need, get fully parametric geometry. No CAD commands to memorize. Uses DeepSeek V4 Flash locally; optional vision pipeline for photo-to-enclosure. Open source on GitHub.
